title: HateMM: A Multi-Modal Dataset for Hate Video Classification

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing the hate speech classification performance (e.g., accuracy, macro-F1 score) of multi-modal models specifically on videos targeting racial groups, such as Black communities, to identify disparate algorithmic performance.

Evaluating and comparing the hate speech classification performance of multi-modal models on videos specifically targeting religious groups, such as Jewish communities, to measure if the detection algorithms are biased toward certain targets.
